source.adoption_scope: Complete merged main snapshot plus six reconciled local patches and targeted open null-pixel fixes

shader_instruction_inventory.scope: Implementation inventory, not shader correctness or GPU acceptance

source.testOnlyReconciliation: Optional-note Linux fixture expects exact module initializer argument/result imports already present in merged upstream; all malformed and bounds cases retained.
source.windowsFileErrorReconciliation: Windows-only NativeWindowsError delegates upstream WindowsFileTime::Failure and preserves original GetLastError for handle-based fchmod ACCESS_DENIED retry; no header, shader, or ABI changes.
source.socketIsOpenReconciliation: Remove duplicate local IsOpen definition; upstream already provides the identical locked map-membership implementation. Family, guest socket bridge and filesystem/socket handle guards remain intact.
source.graphicsSetHelperReconciliation: Remove unchecked duplicate Vulkan descriptor layout/pool helpers; retain checked implementations with strict per-set/per-stage limits and unchanged storage-buffer UAB flags/calls.
source.graphicsUabFixtureReconciliation: Fixture-only capability reconciliation: a default-false storage-buffer UAB capability must reject the 17-buffer request without leaks before explicit true enables the unchanged positive layout/pool and 16-limit negative checks.
source.depthCapabilityFixtureReconciliation: Fixture-only D16/D32 single-sample finite capability queries plus eleven strict missing-query/format/feature/query-result/sample/extent/layer/resource-limit negative controls with zero leaked mock images; nine reuse assertions and all production depth/MSAA/coherence guards retained.
source.wineDispatcherExceptionReconciliation: Resolve trusted ntdll exported data cells, prefer ARM64EC native Unix endpoint, validate/read the entire finite native dispatcher interval before suspension, and retry only that half-open range alongside existing NtContinue/winpthreads guards. Preserve native waits, private/JIT executable code, APC ownership, async AVX and integer/flags bridges; malformed available cells fail explicitly before suspension.
source.windowsFutimesReconciliation: Update the existing owned disk descriptor first. Only an immediately captured ACCESS_DENIED may reopen metadata rights; current original/reopened volume and full128-bit nonzero file IDs must match before any fallback write. Query failures and mismatches fail closed; invalid times, borrowed-handle ownership, precision and errno bookkeeping remain strict.
source.audio3dFixtureReconciliation: Test-only upstream port fixture uses real object reset9 and explicitly expects valid but unimplemented PCM/gain/legacy/unknown attributes to return NOT_SUPPORTED; malformed payloads remain INVALID_PARAMETER. Production Audio3d is byte-identical and still has no object PCM renderer.
source.pin_and_patch_series_encoding: SHA256 of canonical compact JSON with upstreamPin and orderedPatches name/sha256, followed by LF.
source.windowsMetadataOnlyStatReconciliation: Use preceding CRT file/directory mode for path precision queries; borrowed regular descriptors query native Basic+Standard metadata directly, retaining CRT mode/size/link/zero-field semantics and exact times without Wine GetFileType content reads. Only explicit unsupported metadata classes may fall back to CRT, which must classify FIFO/CHR; all other errors fail and the handle is never closed. Original strict timestamp/rename/unlink checks retained and actual pipe/invalid descriptor/path atime assertions added.

windows_futimes_descriptor_repair.actualApiFinding: Owned descriptor metadata updates preserve exact100ns timestamps after rename/unlink; ReOpenFile instead fails on old names or reopens replacement files. Wine permits direct metadata on the data-only handle, so ACCESS_DENIED fallback was not executed by this actual API probe.

windows_metadata_only_stat_repair.actualCausalFinding: Exact native metadata APIs preserve access time, whereas isolated GetFileType, CRT descriptor stat and original production path/descriptor stat change it through a Wine device-placeholder content probe. Exact mtime remains unchanged.
